observations.behavior: Adds a guard to hide the startup status row when setup progress is detected.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog Desktop users to avoid seeing redundant provisioning indicators while an agent run's sandbox or other setup step is actively progressing.

observations.behavior: Implements shared utility to detect if any recorded event belongs to a specific setup group and carries 'in_progress' state.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides deterministic classification of telemetry events for session UIs without requiring access to backend execution context, supporting consistent user-facing behavior across components.

observations.behavior: Passes computed setup-progress flag into chat thread rendering, downstreaming it through multiple component layers.
observations.posthog_connection: Connects the detection logic from P1.F3 directly to the ChatThread and SessionStartupRow, demonstrating end-to-end implementation rather than isolated changes.

review.reason: The change implements a bounded capability: detecting setup progress in conversation items and suppressing startup status rows accordingly. This is demonstrated by adding a new helper, its use in two separate components, and an explicit guard condition. It does not reach Tier 3 because no systemic risk reduction or cross-component dependency analysis is provided; it remains a localized improvement within PostHog Desktop's agent-session workflow.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to PostHog Desktop users who run agents with sandbox provisioning; reduces visual noise while preserving accurate state representation.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on this chunk; absence of test execution results or integration behavior could affect actual benefit realization.
